title: AltVfiPoiId
description: An alternative Verifone assigned identifier used for the POI within Verifone systems for transaction processing. This is also referred to as the Terminal ID (TID). This value maps to DE41 in ISO8583 specification. This identifier may also be used per contract if required. This value is not guaranteed to be globally unique. The unique value is the internally assigned uuid - poiUid which is returned on the response.
